{{Top|leg}}
'''Repair databases''' were software used by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to assist with repair and maintenance tasks. The [["Hatchling" maintenance droid]] made use of a repair database that assisted it in performing repairs on [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
